column3: The heartbeat remained steady throughout the long, dangerous surgery.

Years later, she could still describe every detail of that unforgettable day.

He was vocal about wanting better food in the cafeteria.
She decided to withdraw her application before the deadline.

Her acceptance letter from the university arrived earlier than expected.
